title: insert_outbound_message has 9 params with #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
description: The function now has 9 positional parameters. The allow suppresses the clippy signal permanently. Every new message field (Phase 2: subject, thread_id, expiry, etc.) extends this signature further. A MessageInsertParams struct would name the fields at the call site and make the allow unnecessary. Suggested rewrite: struct MessageInsertParams { id, chat_id, body, body_type, sent_at_peer, created_at_unix, reply_to, attachments, outbox_peers } — caller uses struct literal, compiler catches missing fields.
